definitions.gloss: nuisance behavior; antisocial conduct; disruptive behavior
definitions.explanation: Actions that cause trouble, annoyance, or inconvenience to others in shared spaces. Encompasses a wide range of behaviors from minor rudeness to criminal harassment.

examples.japanese: {迷惑行為|めいわくこうい}はやめてください。
{電車内|でんしゃない}での{迷惑行為|めいわくこうい}が{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: Nuisance behavior on trains is becoming a problem.

examples.japanese: SNSでの{迷惑行為|めいわくこうい}に{対|たい}する{法的|ほうてき}{措置|そち}が{強化|きょうか}されている。
examples.english: Legal measures against antisocial behavior on social media are being strengthened.

notes:
Compound of {迷惑|めいわく} (nuisance, trouble) and {行為|こうい} (act, conduct). A broad term covering any behavior that causes disturbance or inconvenience to others, from loud phone calls on trains to online harassment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {迷惑行為|めいわくこうい}を{禁止|きんし}する — to prohibit nuisance behavior
- {迷惑行為|めいわくこうい}を{通報|つうほう}する — to report disruptive behavior
- {迷惑行為|めいわくこうい}{防止|ぼうし}{条例|じょうれい} — nuisance prevention ordinance
- ネット{上|じょう}の{迷惑行為|めいわくこうい} — online nuisance behavior

EXAMPLES OF {迷惑行為|めいわくこうい}:
- Talking loudly on the phone on public transport
- Blocking doorways or escalators
- Online harassment and trolling
- Filming or photographing people without consent

RELATED WORDS:
- {迷惑|めいわく} — nuisance; trouble; bother
- ハラスメント — harassment
- {不法行為|ふほうこうい} — illegal act; tort
- マナー{違反|いはん} — breach of etiquette
